title: Grateful Dead Live at Riverport Amphitheatre on 1995-07-05
lineage: Nakamichi 300's + CP4's > Sony D7 > 7 pin digi coax> CDR880 (Master) > EAC > AddaWave (Merge Waves) > Sound Forge 3.0 (Fadeouts) > CD Wave > SHN

ai_review.summary: A decent audience recording of an uneven, storm‑soaked show that’s remembered more for its ambience than musical brilliance.
ai_review.review: Listeners note a solid sound capture – the audience recording is praised as clear and easy to stitch together – but the performance itself is described as mediocre, with a slow start, some noodling, and overall only average playing. The concert’s memorable context (traffic jams, lightning‑filled sky) adds nostalgic value despite the lack of standout musical moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is generally rated around average (3‑4 stars) while recording quality receives slightly higher praise; combined weighted rating yields a modest 3.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers compliment the sound and note that discs can be joined seamlessly, indicating clear and usable audience capture with no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert started slowly with some noodling, never fully gaining momentum; overall it is remembered as an average performance despite the dramatic weather and venue atmosphere.
